name: Pre-Hispanic City of Chichen-Itza
description: Chichen Itza is a vast ancient Maya city in Mexico's Yucatán peninsula, between Valladolid and Mérida. Over nearly a thousand years it blended Maya building traditions with influences from central Mexico. Visitors can climb among the stepped pyramid of El Castillo, the Warriors' Temple and El Caracol, a round observatory, all still standing in the jungle.
